items.evidence: leverage play work --ticks 5 --seed 1 --settings fresh: printed one JSON object, screen title, with every key the brief names (tick..records), no-season defaults as specified.
--frame f/title.png --size 800x480 (and 10 other frames): PNG image data, 800 x 480 RGBA.

Fresh run: texts [Day Market, New season, Records, Stamps, Settings, Quit], menu_index 0; up/left at 0 stay 0; 6 downs stop at 4; enter on Quit at tick 10 froze the state with tick 10 in a 20-tick run.

Settings start 'Language: English','Difficulty: Normal','Season: 7 days'; left at English stays, right->Spanish, right stays; difficulty hard/easy ends hold; season 7<->3 ends hold; Escape and Enter on Back -> title.
Set es/normal/3 in one run on folder k2; a second run on k2 started language es, normal, 3. Fresh folder: en, normal, 7, slots [null,null,null], stamps [], records [].

With language es, texts of title, slots, settings, records, stamps, morning, stall, day, paused, evening, upgrades, season over all Spanish (e.g. 'Mañana','Tarde','Mejoras','Fin de temporada'); only 'Day Market' and 'Normal' same. es.json and en.json have the same 96 keys. Settings texts switched to Spanish on the same word.
modules/work/strings/en.json and es.json hold the strings; README 'Add a language' section says how.
Fresh: New season -> texts ['New season','Slot 1: Empty','Slot 2: Empty','Slot 3: Empty']; Escape -> title.
Seed 1, slot 1: screen morning, day 1, slot 1, coins 50, rep 50, every stock [], prices 4/6/11/14/7/9, upgrades [], crate_limit 8, order null, texts 'Morning','Day 1 of 7','Coins: 50'.
Easy+3 days: Coins 60, 'Day 1 of 3', forecast 3 entries; Hard: Coins 40. After giving up and setting Hard/7, Continue showed season_difficulty easy, season_length 3.
Seeds 1..8: 7 entries each of sun/cloud/rain/heat; weather = forecast[day-1] (day 1 rain, day 2 sun for seed 1) and 'Weather:' text follows; seed 1 twice gave the same forecast.
Seeds 1..8 wholesale all inside apples 1-4, bread 2-5, cheese 5-8, fish 6-9, flowers 2-5, honey 4-7; rows read e.g. 'Apples: 2 a unit, stock 0'.
Apples at 2: coins 50->38, stock [{units 6, days_left 5}], second lot -> 12 units one batch, row 'stock 12'; bread batch days_left 1; honey batches days_left null.
Coins 2, Enter on Cheese (7): coins/stock unchanged, 'Not enough coins' added, gone after next word. Saved apples 96, Enter on Apples: nothing changed.
Day 1 order null; day 2 'Order: 4 Apples for 24' (4*4*3/2), other run '6 Honey for 81'; accept -> taken true, 'Order taken: 4 Apples for 24'; second accept no change.
Later run on the same folder: title [New season, Continue, Records,...]; slots row 'Slot 1: Day 1 of 7, 50 coins'.

Continue with seed 7 on a folder saved at day 2 (seed 1): same day, coins 34, rep 62, stock, stall, prices, upgrades [sign], forecast, wholesale 1/5/6/9/5/5 and order as saved; Enter on empty slot 2 changed nothing.

Escape on Morning/Stall/Day -> Paused [Paused, Resume, Title]; in Day clock held at 2 over 20 ticks, Resume and Escape returned to same screen and state (progress kept); Title -> title with slot still '34 coins' though a lot had been bought.
Stall opens cursor (0,0), apples, texts 'Stall','Good: Apples','Price: 4','Stock: 12','Crates: 0 of 8'.
Left/Down at (0,0) stay; Up -> (0,1), Up stays; 6 Rights stop at (5,1); Down -> (5,0).
next_good x6: bread, cheese, fish, flowers, honey, apples; prev_good: honey, flowers; Good/Price/Stock texts followed.
put at (5,0) -> stall gains flowers, 'Crates: 1 of 8'; put again no change; take removes; take on empty no change; 9th put at 8 crates no change.
Flowers price_down x10 stops at 1, price_up x27 stops at 21 (3*7); 'Price:' text followed.
Stall and prices of day 1 unchanged on day 2 morning, and after save + Continue in a later run (seed 7 and seed 9).
Enter on Stall: screen day, clock 0, speed slow, texts '08:00','Speed: Slow', taken/served/walked_out/passed 0, visitors list filled (35 visitors seed 1).
Script check on full-day dumps: ids 1..n, minutes strictly increasing in 0..479, types valid, wants distinct 2/1/2/3; seed 1 twice same list hash, seeds 2..8 different lists.

Slow 20 ticks/min, fast 5 (clock 1 at tick 41 after fast at 36), rush 1; hold kept clock 3 over 30 ticks on screen day; slow 10 ticks then fast reached clock 1 after 3 more ticks (progress kept); '08:01','Speed: Fast' texts followed.
finish at tick 36: state at 37 is evening, clock 480; output identical (md5) to the same day run at rush.
Same day at slow (9800 ticks), rush, finish, and fast/hold/rush/slow/fast/finish mix: identical md5 of coins, taken, served, walked_out, passed, sales, texts, stock.
Per-minute dumps of 4 full days (98 visitors on busy ones): every visitor on aisle at x = clock - m for m..m+5 and off aisle from m+6; no violation.
Checker over 4 days, 180+ takes: every take is from front crate of its column, or back crate only with non-empty basket; only wanted goods not already held.

Cook visitor 9 (minute 156) held 2 apples at 4 at clock 156 at column 0, budget_left 32. Apples price 5: only tourists bought apples (no cooks); price 6: tourists bought at 6; price 7: no apple sales.
Checker: budget_left = budget - spent and never below 0; units held in aisle+queue never above stock, every minute of 4 days.
Checker: empty-basket leavers not queued (passed counts 23/69), goods holders queued with joined m+6 or straight to a till.

Checker: every till ends = start + 2 + goods; sale at end minute, coins/taken up by paid (bargain total - total//10), served/rep +1, stock down by sold; with batches [3 d2, 30 d5] the d2 batch emptied first.
Busy day: 55 cases of a till taking the queue front in the minute its sale ended; visitor 1 left aisle at 8 with free till, at till from 8 (ends 12).
Busy day 13 walkouts, each at wait exactly = patience (none at/above in queue), walked_out +1, rep -2 (after the same-minute +1 clamp), held<=stock held throughout.
At clock 479 one on aisle and one at a till; at evening aisle/queue/tills empty, walked_out 13 and passed 0 unchanged, served unchanged.
Saved season with second_till: tills has 2 entries, both busy in 104 minutes, served 96 vs 83, no front-of-queue order errors.
With Sign and crates only in the back row, visitors with empty baskets took from back crates (passed 0, served 83).
Taken order with 60 apples: coins +24, apples 56, 'Order delivered: 24'; with no apples 'Order failed', rep 50->45; not taken: no line, stock and rep unchanged.
Evening: bread days 1 spoiled 6, fish batches d1 spoiled / d2 -> d1, apples d5->d4, honey kept; spoiled 12 and per-good 'spoiled 6' lines.
Heat day: apples 5->3, fish d2 spoiled; with Cool box apples 5->4, fish d2->d1.
3 crates: Easy 'Rent: 21', Hard 'Rent: 36'; 5 crates Normal 'Rent: 30', 8 crates 36; coins reduced accordingly.

Evening texts 'Evening','Day 1 of 7','Taken: 86','Served: 12','Walked out: 0','Passed: 23', per-good 'Apples: sold 11, spoiled 0, left 1' matching sales/stock, 'Rent: 30','Coins: 64','Reputation: 62','Tomorrow: Sun' (forecast day 2).
Enter on evening -> Upgrades ['Upgrades','Coins: 64','Next day','Second till: 80','Cool box: 40','Sign: 30','Extra crates: 50','Awning: 35']; Next day -> Morning day 2.
Sign bought 64->34, upgrades [sign], 'Sign: owned', again no change; Second till at 64 -> 'Not enough coins', nothing changed; Extra crates -> crate_limit 12, 'Crates: 8 of 12', 9th crate placed.
Coins 5, rent 20: evening 'Coins: -15','Bankrupt', slots all null; Enter -> ['Bankrupt','Score: 0','Days: 2',...]; records [{score 0, days 2, normal, bankrupt true}].
3-day season day 3 coins 100: 'Season over', Enter -> 'Score: 130' (80+50), 'Days: 3', 'Best: 300'; slot emptied; title without Continue.

With 5 records kept, score 130 replaced the 100; a new 150 went after the two older 150s; lines 'Score 300, 7 days, Normal', 'Score 0, 2 days, Normal, bankrupt', 'No records yet'; shown again in a later run.
Day 1: 'Stamp: First coin','Stamp: Sold out'; with first_coin already kept, a paying day showed no First coin line; stamps in order; Stamps screen 'First coin: yes','Sold out: no',... in a later run.
First coin on a day with sales; Full stall with 8 crates (not with 6); Whole season on 3-day last day with coins 80.
Flowers with crates sold out -> Sold out; apples with stock but no crate emptied only by the order -> no stamp.
Day 2 played unbroken vs after Continue (other seed) with same inputs: md5-identical visitors, sales and evening.
Two copies of a kept folder, seed 5, same script, 600 ticks: identical output and identical kept files; seeds 1..8 give different forecasts/wholesale/visitors.
Left/rush/finish on title, rush/finish/put on Morning, accept/rush/finish/hold on Stall, escape/finish/rush/accept/put on Evening: whole state unchanged.
modules/work/data/goods.json, visitors.json, weather.json, upgrades.json, stamps.json, rules.json; README 'Changing things' says how to change each.
Stall frame shows grid, cursor at its cell and the text panel, but bread (133,133,77) and cheese (133,133,63) crates are drawn in nearly the same colour: the six goods are not told apart.
Day frame: stall crates, two regular visitors (green) at aisle cells 1 and 3, a tourist in the queue, bargain (purple) at the till, panel with 10:24, Speed: Hold, Coins, Taken, Served, Reputation.

Title, slots, settings, morning, upgrades, paused, season over frames show texts with '>' on the chosen row, but the Evening frame (two runs) shows only the raw '{work.display}' and the engine warns nothing keeps work.display.
README has How to play, Where things are kept (--settings folder, k_* keys), and both check commands, which ran as written.

defects: Several words at the same tick: only one acts ('1:down,1:down' gives menu_index 1, not 2), against the brief's headless spec (README admits it).
The Evening screen is drawn as the literal placeholder '{work.display}' in frames; the engine prints a warning to that effect on runs that end on the Evening.
Bread and cheese crates are almost the same colour in frames.
A save whose batches are not sorted is used in stored order (remove does not sort); not reachable through play, only by a hand-edited save.
